title: Pyaasi Rehkar Jo Bachati Hai Sakina Paani
body:
Haay sakina....
Pyaasi rehkar jo bachati hai sakina paani,
Tauke aabid pe, girati hai sakina paani....
Abto aankho me bhi aae to chupa leti hai,
Shimr se itna, chupati hai sakina paani....
Ho'nth khulte hai to abbas ada hota hai,
Jab bhi paani ko, bulati hai sakina paani....
Aabe kausar bhi patakta hai faseelo'n pe jabhi,
Jab bhi chullu me, uthati hai sakina paani....
Kisi maskize ke behne se jo uthti hai sada,
Mujhko aawaaz, ye aati hai sakina paani....
Haal aisa hai ke mutthi me uthaae matti,
Zere lab bolti, jaati hai sakina paani....
Tishnagi hai ke ye abbas ka dukh hai akbar,
Khaak pe likhkar, mitati hai sakina paani....
